decisions.scope: UI/UX within approved product requirements; no business/security/architecture/gate waiver
decisions.decision: Direction A / Enterprise Precision as one foundation; B causal impact rail only; C optional compact Grid behavior only.
alternatives_rejected: B as full dark telemetry-style shell: extra pane/color complexity without rendered comparative evidence.
C as global grid-first language: weaker manager/proof-reading emphasis.
Mixed themes or reopening A/B/C selection with PO: incompatible with coherent system and current delegation.
decisions.rationale: Control Room comprehension and sustained evidence reading need a quiet semantic hierarchy; execution benefits from contextual impact and optional density.
evidence: Two isolated source critiques A-02/03/04 and B-01/02/05
TasteSkill Operate guidance; Hallmark counts treated as heuristics
Six saved inspired-by references; no official component package adoption
EV-UI-001 partial screenshot shows readable blocker labels but vertically dominant chain; conditions unknown
approved_constraints: RULE-001/002 distinct types and five axes
Control Room comprehension / Operational Grid execution
No external branding or presumed Carbon/shadcn installation
risks: No full-scale direction comparison or long-session usability study
Inherited review miniatures are not production screens
decisions.implementation_impact: One token namespace and neutral shell, purposeful impact rail/inspector; retain A/B/C boards as archived alternatives labeled with the selection.
validation_needed: Full-scale same-data Control Room/Grid/Evidence specimen under permitted renderer
Contrast/zoom/reflow/focus evaluation; no claimed visual PASS

decisions.scope: UI/UX within approved product requirements; no business/security/architecture/gate waiver
decisions.decision: Comfortable default; Compact opt-in per user/view; density changes presentation, never data/state/permissions.
alternatives_rejected: Compact-only default: long bilingual labels and multi-axis reasons need breathing room.
Automatic density from row count: unpredictable and unapproved as a user preference.
decisions.rationale: 50–200-row operation benefits from optional scan density while preserving discoverability and editing/error context.
evidence: P0 dense Grid/inline and keyboard requirements
approved_constraints: RULE-013 allowlisted metadata and per-row results
Critical state/reason/error and selection/focus remain visible in both densities
No fixed row height clipping long text
risks: Compact may impair target spacing or multiline scanning
decisions.implementation_impact: Body14px/line1.5; metadata12px/line1.5. Comfortable single-line row minimum44px with8px vertical padding; Compact minimum36px with4px padding; multiline grows. Touch controls minimum44px hit area by design choice, not a universal WCAG rule. Default select remains standard; no auto reset after filters/drawers.
validation_needed: Realistic 50/100/200 mixed-state rows; edit/cancel/error recovery with keyboard
Measured focus/targets and 200% reflow; Compact cannot hide critical context

decisions.scope: UI/UX within approved product requirements; no business/security/architecture/gate waiver
decisions.decision: Critical blockers → Next Actions → Waiting On → Upcoming Milestones → Evidence Gaps → Recent Changes; dedicated Important Decisions queue immediately alongside Next Actions.
alternatives_rejected: All left-column evidence/history before next responsible step: loses accountable resolution path.
Hide decisions below history: legal workflow decisions must remain discoverable.
Rank WAITING as actionable: violates RULE-021.
decisions.rationale: Managers need cause, downstream exposure, accountable owner and permitted next step before reviewing secondary detail. Keep the ten-second comprehension target unmeasured.
evidence: EV-UI-001 captured vertical chain, surrounding context not shown
approved_constraints: Next Action only assigned visible Actions NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS + READY; none at Atlas T0
WAITING remains Waiting On; no force READY
Milestones without declared required set UNASSESSED
Decision owner/outcome not supplied must be explicit
risks: Source DOM order does not prove rendered order or ten-second comprehension
Missing fixture owners/prerequisite sets remain unavailable, not invented
decisions.implementation_impact: Flatten section DOM for predictable reading order; blocker full-width, Next Action and decision queue follow, then Waiting On/milestones/evidence/changes. Show internal follow-up owners in the app. Mobile follows the same order. Decisions remain basic contextual records, not new task semantics.
validation_needed: Full-scale manager task: identify blocker/cause/owner/eligible next action or no-candidate reason
DOM/visual/assistive reading order and decision discoverability

decisions.scope: UI/UX within approved product requirements; no business/security/architecture/gate waiver
decisions.decision: Mobile prioritizes overview/blockers/My Actions/Waiting On/detail/evidence status/navigation and permitted simple actions; desktop prioritizes dense Grid, complex bulk, comparisons and high-volume operations.
alternatives_rejected: Read-only blanket mobile restriction: could remove approved responsive actions.
Shrink the full 200-row desktop matrix to phone width: obscures meaning/targets.
Hide records beyond the first eight: violates reachability intent.
decisions.rationale: Responsive alternatives should preserve important information and permitted actions without requiring desktop table geometry.
evidence: P0 responsive scope and permission matrix
R05 mobile limitation and B-03 target concerns
All matching row generation retained in prior correction
approved_constraints: No P0 capability deletion or new permission rule
All matching records reachable through card list/search/filter; not first-eight truncation
Simple edits/submissions obey the same policy; draft/error/conflict retained
Complex bulk: appropriate staged mobile alternative or explicit safe deferred continuation, not a policy ban
risks: My Actions/Waiting On/full submission remain specification-only in this concept
decisions.implementation_impact: Single-column cards and full-screen details; visible owner/reason/state; 44px touch control design token, labels and reversible confirmations. Preserve no-eligible-action state. Mobile bulk scope is presentation sequencing, not a role prohibition.
validation_needed: Allowed mobile viewport/reflow/keyboard/touch tests with last-row/search/reset coverage
Simple-action error/retry and desktop↔mobile continuation without hidden scope loss
